detail:
verdict=deploy-ready; posted and transitioned; caveats:
  - Regression found: on AWS (tenants.mgb.enabled=false) the admin Med Admin Notifications form / In-App Debugger tab with 'Send notification' checked now returns HTTP 500 for demo-demo and demo-qa, because NotificationSimulationService self-posts to /api/integration/mgb/event which is no longer registered; the preview (generate-notification) still works. SimulationController explicitly maps demo-demo and demo-qa, so this path was intended for AWS demo tenants. Needs a follow-up ticket (e.g. have the simulation call MGBNotificationService directly, or gate the self-post) unless that demo simulation is unused on AWS.
  - The AWS profiles themselves were not booted (they need RDS/Secrets); the AWS condition was reproduced by passing -Dtenants.mgb.enabled=false to the local,docker instance, which exercises the same @ConditionalOnProperty gate.
  - qa-suite does not call the simulation send path and the post-merge QA Suite runs on dev (2026-10-23 and 2026-10-26) are green, so the regression is confined to the manual admin tool.
  - Only the controller registration was validated; no HL7 or on-prem OpenShift config was exercised. On-prem profiles leave tenants.mgb.enabled unset, which matchIfMissing=true keeps registered (verified as the baseline here).
